Reviewer recommends rejection: Five sources opened. Nearly every claim checks out, and the dates, scores, records and foundation figures are accurate and still current as of Oct 2026 (the Wimbledon record and Connors match-wins comparison still hold). Rejected over a few small but real problems. Fixes needed: (1) The wife FAQ says 'born Mirka Vavrinec' with no source, and her birth name is reported as Miroslava. Remove it or source it, and add a citation. (2) 'Asked how it felt' gets the 2009 quote's setting wrong: CNN shows he said it to the crowd during the on-court ceremony. Reword it. (3) 'He played one match there' is not in nbc-laver. Cite a source or drop 'one'. (4) The page names minor children while marked risk: medium. Under the style guide, minors mean risk: high, or drop the names. (5) 'Three decades later' is inexact (1993/94 to 2022). (6) Answer the age query: he is 45, born 8 August 1981 [s:britannica]. Once these are fixed, the page should pass.
